description_en: Migrates the experiment directory from PAI Studio 1.0
kebab_example: aliyun paistudio migrate-experiment-folders --workspace-id 12345 --is-owner true --accessibility PRIVATE --api-version 2021-02-02 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MigrateExperimentFolders

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to migrate only your own experiments
parameters.name: is_owner

parameters.help_en:
The visibility of the workflow draft. Valid values:
PUBLIC: visible to all members in the workspace.
PRIVATE: visible only to you and administrators in the workspace
parameters.help_zh:
工作流草稿的可见性，取值如下：
PUBLIC：在此工作空间中，对所有人可见。
PRIVATE：在此工作空间中，仅对您和管理员可见
parameters.name: accessibility
